notice: Light news day — most scouts returned empty. Today's edition focuses on AI tools and startups.

lead.title: Zro launches private inference for AI coding agents
lead.summary: Zro unveiled a private inference service purpose-built for AI coding agents, offering secure model hosting with native integrations for popular development tools. The platform runs on LiteLLM, Z.ai, and NVIDIA infrastructure, targeting teams that need isolated, compliant inference for agentic code workflows.

top_stories.title: Manta AI deploys autonomous agents for web app testing
top_stories.summary: Give Manta AI a URL and it explores your app like a real user — mapping flows, finding bugs, and generating self-healing test cases from plain English. Runs locally for testing behind firewalls.

top_stories.title: Bond turns the to-do list into a self-managing AI chief of staff
top_stories.summary: Bond connects to your tools, learns company workflows, and transforms scattered tasks into a self-managing list that can draft follow-ups, create action items, and delegate. Topped Product Hunt with 188 upvotes.

top_stories.title: Graft AI maps enterprise workflows into agent-callable tools
top_stories.summary: Graft AI learns how work gets done across legacy apps and screen-based workflows, then exposes stable agent-callable APIs with permissions, approvals, and audit trails. Automatically detects and repairs UI drift.

items.title: River deploys voice-AI account executives to close B2B deals
items.summary: River's voice-AI agents join live calls the moment a lead inquires, run product demos, handle objections, and close deals. Backed by founders of Ramp, Kalshi, and Lean.

items.title: Tencent EdgeOne lets developers deploy AI agents at the edge
items.summary: Tencent EdgeOne Makers treats AI agent deployment like shipping a web app, leveraging Tencent's global edge network for low-latency inference. Reached 164 upvotes on Product Hunt.

items.title: Nitrosend builds email infrastructure for AI agents
items.summary: Nitrosend gives AI agents their own email layer: agents can sign up for accounts, send emails, and reply autonomously, enabling fully automated email-based workflows.

items.title: Ratel gives agents unlimited tools without context bloat
items.summary: Open-source framework that lets AI agents access unlimited external tools and skills dynamically, without consuming context window tokens. Launched as a Show HN on Hacker News.

items.title: Albato connects AI-driven workflows across 1,000+ apps
items.summary: No-code automation platform that connects over 1,000 apps and lets users build complex branching workflows by chatting with an AI Copilot or deploying agents in natural language.

quick_hits.title: Codema launches two technical committees for continuous AI assessment standards
